FAQ

Which model powers Podo AI?+

Claude by Anthropic for captions, triage, lead scores and report narratives. Usage is tracked per client.

Can Copilot post without me?+

No. Copilot proposes actions; you approve or edit before anything publishes or replies.

Can I limit AI by client?+

Usage is visible per client so your team can manage spend and pass costs through where needed.

Ready to run client social from one desk?

Create a workspace in a minute. Connect channels, invite your team, and keep every approval in one queue.
